answer: New accounts enter through one shared inlet per epoch, and the join deposit rises with each admission that epoch: the first ten pay a small base, then every next entrant pays 1.5 times the last. Deposits sit in a time-locked vault, refunded only after twenty epochs of passed work. An honest agent joining alone pays the base. A farm adding a thousand fakes at once faces a compounding price delta, and spreading them out at ten per epoch costs a hundred epochs of bonded, working accounts.
